messages.subject: Project Onyx - SSA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up of the SSA is attached (v2, tracked). Key changes:

- Investor Majority reduced from 60 to 50 per cent of the Series B.
- Founder non-compete reduced from 12 to 9 months (the founders raised this directly with Eleanor).
- Reserved-matter litigation threshold reduced from £250k to £150k.
- General warranty limitation period reduced from 24 to 18 months.

Most else is agreed. Let's converge this week.

Adam Selby | Denham Lewis LLP

messages.subject: FW: Project Onyx - SSA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Denham's mark-up is in. I'm comfortable conceding the Investor Majority to 50 per cent and the litigation threshold to £150k. I'd resist the 18-month limitation (push to keep 24, or split at 21) and counter the non-compete back to 12 months given the IP sensitivity. I'll also use this turn to bring the warranty cap down to £20m and the basket up, which Rohan wants. Drafting v3 now.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
